description: Context: Customers in regulated industries requested stricter guarantees around where KMS-wrapped keys can be used and improved audit visibility for RBAC v2 actions. This PR introduces enforcement of KMS region residency constraints at the RBAC policy layer and enriches audit logs with KMS metadata to make investigations and compliance attestations easier. Motivation: Close a gap where cross-region KMS usage could bypass organizational data residency intents and improve forensic fidelity for encryption-related operations. Changes: - Implemented a KMS residency checker that validates KMS key region against configured residency policies at policy evaluation time; policy evaluation returns a detailed reason for deny decisions. - Augmented audit pipeline to include kms_region, kms_key_id, and residency_check_outcome in structured JSON logs. - Added DB migration to persist residency policy versioning and a lightweight enforcement flag. - Updated Helm chart configmap to expose residency policy as an opt-in override for Dedicated/Private deployments. - Added unit and integration tests, and an integration CI job to run with a mocked KMS emulator. Backwards compatibility: Residency checks are behind a feature flag (rbac.v2.kms_residency_enforce=false by default) and the policy enforcer falls back to audit-only mode when not enforced. Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-6123) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added and stabilized after a flaky DB test rerun - [x] Docs updated (docs/security/kms-region-residency.md) - [x] Migration script included - [x] Security scan passed Notes: There was an intermittent integration failure on the first CI run related to the test DB snapshot; rerunning fixed the failure after the migration ordering was corrected. This change is intended to be non-breaking by default (enforcement off), but operators enabling enforcement should follow the migration steps in docs to avoid unexpected denies. Related: SUP-345, SEC-129, ENG-6123.

release_notes: Adds optional enforcement of KMS region residency for RBAC v2 and enhances audit logs with KMS metadata. Enforcement is opt-in and disabled by default; operators should run the included migration and follow the docs before enabling.
